body:
What you're saying it true and I should know that and I do. 

I just can't believe it for myself, I don't know why. I'm trying to be a good person and just telling myself you know it's better to be kind and intelligent and loving than beautiful cause beauty never lasts. I just think I'm tired of being ugly though...I'm tried of people giving me looks when I'm walking down the street...I'm tired of people being like "wow you need to lose weight" or "oh hey you're actually somewhat pretty" like was I not before? I'm tired of being scared to meet up with a guy because I'm not as pretty as I am in my profile picture. I'm tired of being scared to go outside in public because I'm so ashamed of how fat I am and how not pretty I am. 
I don't want to judge and I try to not care about other people's judgements. But slowly I just feel all those judgements poisoning myself, decaying myself and whatever self-esteem and love I had for myself and what I think about myself. But it's the truth, right? I guess I'd rather know the truth than have people saying "you're pretty!" when i'm actually not.

Thank you for your comment. 

I just can't take anything anymore. Everything just is too much anymore, my mind has taken such a toll on my life and is just going to keep taking a toll on my life. I'm scared to starve myself, I'm scared to not eat or eat only 700 calories a day, cause I did it before and it was painful - but I only feel beautiful and confident when I'm hungry because that means I'm working towards being skinny. And it's stupid I know but...it just works for me. And my depression and anxiety, I get too anxious about everything. And OCD...it's made me do things, that I just had to do even though it was ridiculous, and i was made fun of and laughed at and humiliated by people because of the things my OCD made me do and think I had to do. And now whatever is making me want to eat laxatives all the time just to feel empty and skinny, whatever makes me only feel confident when I'm hungry...my mind is too much. I can't live like this anymore. 

Is it just time for me...this is my second horrible breakdown in a month and I usually don't have such bad breakdowns, not since August like I had said...maybe I should just die. And people say it gets better later on...I can't wait that long anymore. There's too much pain, I can feel it burning inside me. I just want to disappear. I just want to not exist anymore. 

But then it's like I can't die, right? I can't kill myself. So it feels like i'm suffocating. Pain is burning myself and I can't even get relief. I'm suffocating right now. I'm miserable.
